objects.name: Analytic 1804
objects.description: For Android, detect Process Discovery by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate File Access via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: opendir('/proc/') with recursive listdir by app NOT IN $ProcessDiscoveryAllowList$ on device with android_version < $HidepidVersion$]; Network Connection Creation via Android Enterprise Network Logging / Enterprise VPN [DevicePolicyManager.retrieveNetworkLogs(): DnsEvent / ConnectEvent; VPN flow metadata]; Process Metadata via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: running process names read from /proc/<PID>/status or /proc/<PID>/cmdline by app NOT IN $ProcessDiscoveryAllowList$]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.
